investigated_problem: Maturity recognition and grouping of individual fruitbodies into harvestable flushes
dataset: MushR oyster grow-tent images; annotated train/test COCO set
baseline: Detectron2 Mask R-CNN; area-weighted maturity; DBSCAN spatial grouping
reported_results: Paper reports Mask R-CNN segmentation AP 49.332 overall and ready-class AP 61.083; separate training accuracy language should not be treated as test accuracy
author_stated_limitations: Three species-independent mapping is not established; only oyster mushroom maturity classes are available
independently_observed_limitations: Maturity classes are source-specific and crop/fruitbody labels differ from daily cluster tracking
proposed_system_adaptation: Use its model/data and area-weighted grouping as a plug-in maturity component after mapping the output to cluster-level records
supporting_evidence: Paper sections 4 and Appendix A; public repository and release link
contradictory_evidence: MushR does not provide a general multi-species model or cross-camera cluster tracking out of the box

investigated_problem: Detection/instance segmentation and RGB-D/growth monitoring for button mushrooms
dataset: M18K V2, with existing repository experiments
baseline: Existing repo: YOLOv8n-seg, two-class and WB-only
reported_results: Existing V2 run reports good WB-only AP and area analysis; exact M18K paper-protocol reproduction not claimed
author_stated_limitations: Observed severe label imbalance, split/QC questions and unverified depth calibration
independently_observed_limitations: A WB-only trained checkpoint does not prove performance on oyster or other mushroom species
proposed_system_adaptation: Retain M18K pipeline for software/benchmark regression and possible mixed-domain general detection after data QC
supporting_evidence: Existing Day1–5 notebooks, reports, metrics and M18K public repo
contradictory_evidence: No direct evidence that adding raw depth improves segmentation or physical sizing without calibration

investigated_problem: Cluster segmentation, temporal identity association and growth measurement
baseline: Mask R-CNN; ConvNeXt-Tiny / Swin backbones; confidence/overlap/substrate-aware postprocessing; mask-IoU tracking
reported_results: Paper demonstrates temporal tracking and relative growth monitoring across time-lapse sequences
author_stated_limitations: Adaptation must respect different viewpoint, fixed column/camera identity and possible multiple mushroom species
independently_observed_limitations: Cross-view/cross-column association is not required and may cause identity switches; source sequence split and ID annotation must be inspected
proposed_system_adaptation: Implement same-view, grow-unit-scoped track IDs; retain tracks across temporary occlusion; record new/missing/reappeared/harvested events
supporting_evidence: Paper, Zenodo dataset and UCD thesis supplementary-code annex
contradictory_evidence: Target-scene camera geometry and per-column identity metadata are not yet provided

investigated_problem: Real-time growth-stage instance segmentation for P. pulmonarius
dataset: 1,261 image dataset available on reasonable request
baseline: GSP-RTMDet with SPPF-SAM, CSP-SGE and CARAFE (paper description)
reported_results: Paper evaluates seven-stage classification and instance segmentation
author_stated_limitations: Public dataset/code not found; species-specific classes
independently_observed_limitations: A single seven-stage mapping may not transfer to oyster, button or other species
proposed_system_adaptation: Use the seven-stage idea as an optional source of stage labels; define site-specific stage mapping and allow unknown
supporting_evidence: Paper details and reported dataset statement
contradictory_evidence: Exact independent training reproduction is unavailable without original dataset
